model.description: Provider model id; the template carries ctx.model (strict, resolved at instantiation). Convention (K-H2): pass a RESOLVED literal; the MODEL_* literal lane resolves only at the next boot (documented behavior).

description.purpose: The writer half of the summarizer: one provider call per close batch, prose in, prose out. It is offered no tools and holds no identity of its own - its system state is the instructions the prep sends fresh with every batch.
description.use_when: Inside the summarizer hive only. finish_reason drives the two internal return edges: stop/length back to prep as the answer, error/content_filter back to prep as the failure.
description.not_in_scope: No tool round (no tools are offered; a tool_calls answer would die unrouted). No retry - retry is edge business. Not the agent's brain: this cell never sees a live turn, only closed sessions.
description.emits_meaning: finish_reason 'stop'/'length' -> ./prep in_answer (a 'length' summary is truncated but real - better a cut handover than none); 'error'/'content_filter' -> ./prep in_error (MUST stay wired).
description.consumes_meaning: messages[] one prompt document per batch; body.system upserted pre-call (system.instructions, sent by prep).
examples: prompt document -> one assistant turn with the handover prose, finish_reason stop
